name: Pull Request

description: |
  ## Description
  Brief summary of changes
  
  Fixes #(issue number)
  
  ## Type of Change
  - [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing issue)
  - [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
  - [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
  - [ ] Documentation update
  
  ## How Has This Been Tested?
  - [ ] Unit tests added/updated
  - [ ] Integration tests added/updated
  - [ ] Manual testing on local dev environment
  - [ ] Manual testing on staging cluster
  
  ## Checklist
  - [ ] Code follows PEP 8 style guide (flake8 passes)
  - [ ] Tests added and passing
  - [ ] Documentation updated
  - [ ] No breaking changes (or documented migration)
  - [ ] Commits follow conventional commit format
  - [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials
  - [ ] Reviewed my own code before requesting review
  
  ## Screenshots (if applicable)
  Add screenshots for UI/dashboard changes
  
  ## Additional Notes
  Any additional context or considerations
